name: Culke no Yuuutsu
source:
Lately, Kirche has been feeling anxious about how she’s been fading into the background.  
One day, she stumbles upon a book containing secret techniques.  
Drawn to a spell labeled “Magic to Enslave the Opposite Sex,” she chants the incantation…  
But the spell backfires, transforming her into a futanari.  
Staring down at her new, impressive appendage, she thinks:  

“With this magnificent cock, I’ll defile the woman who stole my spotlight…!!”  

And so begins Kirche’s revenge…

translation:
最近，基什（Kirche）对自己逐渐淡出背景感到焦虑。
有一天，她偶然发现一本包含秘密技术的书。
她被一个标有“奴役异性的魔法”的咒语所吸引，她吟诵着这个咒语……  
但咒语适得其反，将她变成了扶他。
低头看着她令人印象深刻的新肢体，她想：

“用这大鸡巴，我要玷污那个偷了我聚光灯的女人……！！”  

Kirche的复仇就这样开始了……
